\section{Verbatim}
% [V1] \verb with several delimiters; payloads hold a backslash and a percent sign
Inline \verb|\catcode`\%=12|, \verb!a|b!, \verb*|two  spaces| and \verb+x+.
% [V2] \lstinline in brace and delimiter forms; a % inside the payload
Tactic \lstinline{exact?} and \lstinline!x % y!.
% [V3] \verb inside a caption, made safe by \cprotect
\begin{figure}[h]
\centering\fbox{figure}
\cprotect\caption{A caption with \verb|\x_y|.}
\end{figure}
% [V4] verbatim inside a group; the payload looks like structure. The kernel
% drops the rest of the \end{verbatim} line, so the group closes on its own line.
{\small\begin{verbatim}
\begin{document} % not a real one
\end{verbatim}
}
% [V5] lstlisting with escapeinside and mathescape
\begin{lstlisting}[language=Python,escapeinside={(*@}{@*)},mathescape]
def f(x):  # (*@\textbf{escaped}@*) and $\alpha$
    return x % 2
\end{lstlisting}
% [V6] a custom listings environment with an optional argument
\begin{gmcode}[language={[LaTeX]TeX}]
\makeatletter \def\x{%}
\end{gmcode}
% [V7] a tcolorbox listing environment
\begin{gmprompt}{Prompt}
{"role": "user", "content": "50% done"}
\end{gmprompt}
% [V8] fancyvrb with commandchars: \textbf is live inside the verbatim body
\begin{cfgblock}
key: \textbf{value}   % kept
\end{cfgblock}
% [V9] verbatim input files, one through a parametric macro
\VerbatimInput{listings/prompt.txt}
\gmlisting{snippet.py}
% [V10] semi-verbatim arguments
\path{a/b_c.txt}, \url{https://example.org/a%20b?x=1#frag}, \nolinkurl{x@example.org}
and \detokenize{\[ \mathrm{CH_2} \]}.
% [V11] payload text before \end{verbatim} on the closing line
\begin{verbatim}
first line
last line\end{verbatim}
